comment: Final bounded B110 M-to-M setup correction. The newt route reached only the weapon attack because its 1d4 hit killed the target; this route uses three hostile wolves, which have no C-defined armor or helmet and enough hit points to survive that first blow. The genesis quantity remains inside the prompt text per read.c:create_particular_parse. After two wait turns, a space acknowledges the expected attack More prompt. Completion requires a C-traced mind-flayer AT_TENT/AD_DRIN call to eat_brains against a wolf.
